> Public P&Ls already draw huge attention in memecoins, and larger markets let successful traders scale and share positions without the same liquidity constraints.
Source:
https://x.com/blknoiz06/status/2111395326280307036

tweet.text:
i expect social trading to get a lot bigger as it expands into liquid markets like stocks and perps

we've already seen how much attention public P&Ls can attract in memecoins, but larger markets make it easier for successful traders to scale their positions and share trades without the same liquidity constraints

once people start seeing massive P&Ls on stocks like Apple or Amazon, i think the appeal of following and copying skilled traders becomes much broader

there's a lot more room for social trading to grow beyond memecoins
